name: Healthcare Practice Management: End-of-day close-out
description: Weekdays at 17:00, closes out each practice's day: today's attended appointments with no treatment note (or only a draft) or no invoice, open Cliniko invoices over 14 days old that Xero doesn't show as paid, and tomorrow's patients with forms still incomplete. Drafts up to 5 payment follow-ups (at most one per invoice per week, escalating gently, never threatening) into WorkQ with the Practice Manager message approval form attached. Nothing is sent until approved. Saves the summary as a document, notifies and emails the practice's digest recipients.
